verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents first-party edge evaluation on Cloudflare Workers, covering feature flags and Visual Editor experiments run server-side or hybrid before HTML ships to avoid flicker. It also provides a self-hosted Proxy as a relay layer that caches SDK payloads, cuts latency, keeps serving flags if the API is down, and streams updates. Missing for 10: evidence of edge support beyond Cloudflare (e.g. other CDN or edge runtimes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of edge or relay deployments.
